/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropSpecialItem.name: Argon Combo #2
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropSpecialItem.description: On Weakpoint kill: chance to drop Health Orbs, Energy Orbs, Ammo, Pheroglands, or SporeX Charges increased by 20%

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ToxinGasResista.name: Breathless
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ToxinGasResista.description: Gain 100% resistance to Gas and Toxin for 30s. Collected Health Orbs add 20s.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropHealingBurg.name: Burgerfest
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropHealingBurg.description: Enemies have a 15% chance of dropping Argon Burger Boxes that can heal nearby allies by 10% and defense targets by 100.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerSporePri.name: Catscratch Fever
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerSporePri.description: Every 20s, an enemy within 30m is affected by Saryn's Spores.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/CreateShieldOnH.name: Crushing Chills
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/CreateShieldOnH.description: Heavy Slam with 6x combo creates up to 3 Snow Globes on a 10s cooldown.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemySho.name: Doktor's Orders
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemySho.description: Equip an EFV-8 Mars with +450% damage as a secondary weapon.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropEfervonGren.name: Fly, Fly!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DropEfervonGren.description: Enemies have a 15% chance to drop grenades that clear Hell-Scrubber contamination.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DeathPrevention.name: Hi-Score
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DeathPrevention.description: Gain 20 points per kill, 100 per Weakpoint Kill. Bonus revives at 1000, 2500, 5000 points.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/CreateChasingAn.name: It Sees You
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/CreateChasingAn.description: An Anti-Matter drop appears 25m away and gives chase every 20s. Gain 1 Pix Chip on success.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ToxinProcOnDama.name: Old Pizza
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ToxinProcOnDama.description: On Damaged: 6% chance to receive Toxin status. Cooldown: 5s. Gain 1 Pix Chip on success.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemyMel.name: Only Knives
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemyMel.description: Equip Scaldra Dual Viciss with +450% damage as melee weapons.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/FreezePlayerOve.name: Optimism
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/FreezePlayerOve.description: Build Cold stacks every 8s. Freezing at 10 stacks for 3s. Roll or Void Sling to thaw 3 stacks.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/NPCReviveSticke.name: Panic Call
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/NPCReviveSticke.description: Minerva or Velimir will attempt to revive you. 30s cooldown.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemyRif.name: Resolutions
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemyRif.description: Equip a Purgator 1 with +450% damage as a primary weapon.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/RemoveStatusesO.name: Reverse-O
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/RemoveStatusesO.description: On Heavy Attack Hit: transfer negative status effects onto enemies within 10m.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/EjectButtonStic.name: Slippery Customer
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/EjectButtonStic.description: First time downed: teleport to safety, revive with 50% HP/Shields, invulnerable for 9s.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/NullStarOnWeakp.name: Spinnin' Around
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/NullStarOnWeakp.description: Weakpoint kills generate 1 Null Star (max 18). Null Stars reduce damage by 5%.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ElementalAmmoCh.name: Super Scavenger
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/ElementalAmmoCh.description: On Eximus Kill: 45% chance to drop an Elemental Ammo Pack.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemySmg.name: Through My Heart
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/StickerEnemySmg.description: Equip an EFV-5 Jupiter with +450% damage as a primary weapon.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DecoyOnDamagedS.name: Too Hot
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/DecoyOnDamagedS.description: Taking damage below 70% HP creates a Molt clone every 10s.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/AllowNecramechS.name: Vintage Tech
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/AllowNecramechS.description: Summon a Necramech. 60s cooldown after destroyed.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/AllowThermianRp.name: Wakeup Call
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/AllowThermianRp.description: A loaded Thermian RPG can be deployed from the Gear Wheel. 60s cooldown.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/SuperGlideParko.name: Walking on Air
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/SuperGlideParko.description: Increase Aim Glide and Wall Latch duration +100%. Lowers gravity by 100%.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/WeaponColdDamag.name: XL Frosty
/Lotus/Upgrades/Stickers/WeaponColdDamag.description: Adds +30% Cold Damage to primary and secondary weapons.
